resources.string: This section explains how ATTEND PRO handles Store and Employee data and provides links to the privacy policy and data deletion request.

When Store geofencing is enabled, the Employee app may collect location data to enable phone-proximity detection and geofence alerts even when the app is closed or not in use. Proximity state, distance, accuracy and observation time may be sent to the Store Management server. Location alone never records check-in or check-out automatically.
ATTEND PRO verifies connections and app identity using its security controls. Server backups are encrypted by the app before upload.
A deletion request for Store or Employee data can be started from the deletion page. Final destructive deletion is not performed until ownership and authority are verified.
No browser is available on this device.
